why: Only draft (R1, the 18 Oct rebuild: scrolling board, plan as maths, numbers moving into one log, M orange / N blue); scored as fixed.
notes: Maths and order match the approved cut: same base so combine, plan + → ×, − → ÷, Add Power with M orange / N blue, 5 and 6 move into one log, 30, Minus Power, 30 and 10 move into one log, log₃3 = 1 boxed, one Watch out at the end.

Beats 6 and 7 (and 11 and 12) were one sentence split across two beats ('So the five goes inside one log,' / 'and the six goes in beside it…'): a student who jumps to beat 7 hears a fragment starting 'and'. Fixed: each beat is a whole sentence ('…inside one log first.' / 'Then the six goes in beside it, with a times sign…'); cues unchanged.
Beat 14 said 'so the log is one' but never the reason the note gives (a¹ = a). Fixed: 'Three to the power one is three, so the log is one.'

Beat 16 circled the 6 inside log₃(5 × 6), but the mistake is about the times sign; and the voice said 'log five times log six' while the ✗ note says log base three. Fixed: circle and note on the × token, the voice reads 'log base three of …' to match the note.

6.say: So the five goes inside one log first.

7.say: Then the six goes in beside it, with a times sign: log base three of five times six.

11.say: So thirty goes inside one log first.

12.say: Then ten goes in after it, divided: log base three of thirty divided by ten.

14.say: The base is three and the number inside is three. Three to the power one is three, so the log is one.
asks: Why is log base 3 of 3 equal to 1?

16.say: Watch out: log base three of five, times log base three of six, is not log base three of thirty. Only added logs combine.
asks: Why can't I multiply two logs?

do.on: is not log base three of thirty
